card.name: Inside citation and patent numbers
card.fires_on: Digits and separators inside patent or document numbers, and the last word of a journal title, in reference lists and citations.

modes.label: Patent number digits
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a patent or publication number.

modes.label: Journal title end
modes.description: The final word of a journal or book title in a reference entry, before the volume or comma.

modes.label: Date separators in codes
modes.description: A slash or hyphen inside a dated reference code or URL.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of reference numbers and journal titles in citation lists, where the next piece is more digits or a volume number.
